name: Coven Mother (Paragon Hag Archetype)
body:
Although covens don’t generally have formal leaders, it’s common for one hag to rise to the top. A few paragon hags are naturals at this role, gathering coven-mates to them with disturbing ease.

Coven’s Soul (Su)

A coven mother gains a number of soul points equal to her Charisma modifier, which are tied into her coven rather than a physical object. She can use her soul points only when adjacent to another member of her coven and must make a concentration check to cast spells, as though missing her soul focus, if she lacks any coven-mates. This ability modifies soul focus.

Coven Feats

At 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th level, the coven mother gains a bonus coven or teamwork feat. She must still qualify for these feats normally. This replaces her family abilities at those levels.

Legendary Mother (Su)

At 20th level, a coven mother may spend a soul point as an immediate action when another member of her coven fails any ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. They reroll that attempt, but must take the new result. This ability replaces legendary family.
